name: caol.reference_camp_gear_reentry_focused_mcw
description: Owner-reference saved-camp continuation for an actual zombie alarm and appropriate-guard response.

permitted_input: advertised native zombie placement as zero-credit setup
forbidden_input: direct NPC action, perception, alarm, attack, damage, lead, hostile contact, clock, payment or return injection

steps.label: observe_reference_camp
steps.objective: Reopen the exact native owner-reference save after observed day patrol. Inspect actual residents, loadouts, day/reserve duties and opportunity. Use ordinary job-priority controls as disclosed setup if needed, then disclose one supported native visible hostile zombie placement as zero-credit opportunity setup. Observe actual detection, alarm, appropriate guard mobilization and native combat outcome; record eligibility and exclusions per actor. Save and exit normally.
proof_targets: exact saved source and installed world identity, player, camp, residents and game time
actual per-actor loadout, duty, reserve/active status, eligibility and opportunity
native zombie detection and actual camp alarm
actual response or evidenced exclusion for each appropriate guard and native combat outcome
native exit and exact process custody
invariants: saved start, ordinary priority management and zombie placement are disclosed zero-credit setup
do not inject alarm, NPC perception, attack, guard action, damage or encounter outcome
do not require both residents to be on duty or attack simultaneously; record real per-actor eligibility and exclusions
prior equipment transfer and persistence retain their original run scope; do not assume current loadout or replay acquisition
do not repeat earlier physical source or signal journey
